messages:
Priya: thinking out loud — we need a clear export/event shape for policy/routing changes so security/compliance teams can answer \"who changed what and why\" without shipping TBs of full-state snapshots. proposals?
Alex: +1. main questions: full snapshot vs compact diff? linkability to rollout ids? console deep-link?
Miguel: i'd lean compact diffs (before/after only for changed fields) + a stable anchor (resource_version) so you can rehydrate if needed. full snapshots only on-demand.
Tanvi: telemetry/cost note — streaming full snapshots for every change will spike egress/ingest. compact diffs + optional snapshot-on-request keeps costs bounded. also consider sampling for low-risk tenants.
Priya: proto-sketch idea: NDJSON stream where each event is an immutable change record. include: actor, actor_source (console/api/svc), timestamp, change_type, resource_id, diff (compact), rollout_id?, justification string. example:
```
{"event_id":"e-01","ts":"2026-03-10T15:22:01Z","actor":"alex","actor_source":"console","resource":"route:tenant-123","change_type":"update","diff":{"rules":{"$set":[{"match":"/v1/*","backend":"blue"}]},"meta":{"timeout":{"from":200,"to":150}}},"rollout_id":"r-9b4f","reason":"reduce timeout for latency"}
```
Miguel: +1 to the NDJSON. i'd add a `snapshot_ref` optionally pointing to a presigned snapshot file for legal/ed discovery. keeps the event small but gives full-state when required.
Lena: add KMS envelope metadata on snapshot_ref so we know which key/tenant to use when requesting. Private deployments will want different handling (customer-managed keys).
Alex: UX question — console should show an expandable inline diff for quick eyeballing, and a \"download full-state\" button which triggers snapshot generation if none exists. button must show estimated size & retention.
Tanvi: quotas — snapshot generation should be rate-limited per-tenant and cost-annotated. maybe a monthly snapshot budget + approval flow for enterprises.
Priya: PII/redaction: events need actor identity for audit, but diffs might include secrets or tokens. propose schema-level redaction markers + export-time redaction mode (none/partial/full).
Miguel: +1. also add `pii_masking` boolean on event and `redacted_fields` list when partial redaction applied. consumers can opt-in to see raw with approval.
export-bot: [system] export-job created: job_id=job-5723 tenant=tenant-123 requested_by=Priya mode=ndjson diff_only=true
Alex: integration: public API path GET /audit/changes?resource=route&since=ts returns NDJSON stream. POST /audit/snapshots to request snapshot (async).
Priya: action items: (1) Miguel to write compact diff proto draft, (2) Lena to spec snapshot KMS metadata, (3) Tanvi to propose quota + cost UI text, (4) Alex to wire console preview + download CTA. back here EOD Friday?
Miguel: will post draft proto in #eng-proto tomorrow.
Lena: i'll map kms variants to tenancy model and share constraints.
Tanvi: will sketch quota UX and sample rates.
Priya: thanks — this feels like a good path forward. we'll avoid full-streaming snapshots by default and preserve linkability to rollouts/evidence for compliance. :thumbsup:
